line.comment: * Add-Ons 1.8: Added Yaki since they too can get the fortress perk.
* Add-Ons 1.13.2: The maximum amount is no longer 20 for the player. It is now 10. This is because the lasertower respawn is now 8 hours instead of 20, meaning they spawn 2.5x faster.
* 24 spawn attempts. Each time a laser is to be spawned, check the cap.
* Add-Ons 1.13.2: Fixed by check the cap. Once the cap is reached, stop spawning LTs and check for OWP.
* Check that the new lasertower position is not too close to other lasertowers. If it is too close, get a new point and try again.
* Note: some reason these lasertowers can spawn only in for the player. Once it's spawned in, append it to the list.
* Add-Ons 1.8: NPC may build extra OWPs or rebuild missing ones.
* Add-Ons 1.8: Better call Mayhem.BuildShip so that it's properly initialized.
